title: Service Account Identity
description: Identity schema for machine-to-machine (M2M) service accounts and API clients

email.title: Service Account Email
email.description: Technical email for the service account (e.g. my-service@serviceaccounts.yourdomain.com)

service_name.title: Service Name
service_name.description: Human-readable name of the service (e.g. payment-service, analytics-worker)

service_id.title: Service ID
service_id.description: Unique identifier for the service (from application registry)

scopes.title: Allowed Scopes
scopes.description: OAuth2 scopes this service account is allowed to request

allowed_ips.title: Allowed IP Addresses
allowed_ips.description: CIDR ranges from which this service account can authenticate

expires_at.title: Expiration Date
expires_at.description: When this service account expires (null = no expiration)

contact.title: Owner Contact Email
contact.description: Email of the team/person responsible for this service account
